_comment: The three delegation choices shown as cards after the biometric check passes. 'action' fills the blank in: 'Your custodian is about to <action> in 10 seconds.' Edit these strings and video paths to match your footage.

cautious.label: Cautious Persona
cautious.blurb: Your custodian checks in before acting. Slower, but nothing happens without you.

balanced.label: Balanced Persona
balanced.blurb: Your custodian acts alone on routine matters and defers to you on the rest.

autonomous.label: Autonomous Persona
autonomous.blurb: Your custodian acts on your behalf without consultation. Fastest, least oversight.
